title: spermacoce litoralis
intro: Spermacoce litoralis, commonly known as Beach St. Paul's Wort, is a plant species in the family Rubiaceae. It is valued for its health benefits, including its anti-inflammatory, antioxidant, and antimicrobial properties, which can help to soothe wounds, reduce fever, and combat infections. The therapeutic actions of Spermacoce litoralis include analgesia, anti-diarrheal, and anti-hemorrhagic effects, making it a potential treatment for various health conditions. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, alkaloids, and terpenoids, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
